ex.en: The invention of the internet marked a new epoch in communication.
ex.zh: 互联网的发明标志着通信的新纪元。

words.note: epoch 指重大事件开启的时代，常见 a new epoch in。

ex.en: Their new design proved highly saleable among young buyers.
ex.zh: 他们的新设计在年轻买家中很畅销。

words.note: saleable 是 sale 加 -able；美式也拼作 salable。

ex.en: The crew worked through the night to repair the damaged engine.
ex.zh: 船员们通宵修理受损的发动机。

words.note: crew 是集合名词，指全体成员，强调个体时可用复数。

ex.en: The manufacturer recalled the product after several complaints.
ex.zh: 收到几起投诉后，制造商召回了该产品。

words.note: manufacturer 由 manufacture 加 -er，指制造商。

ex.en: The team refused to admit defeat after losing the first game.
ex.zh: 输掉第一场比赛后，球队拒绝认输。

words.note: admit defeat 是固定说法「认输」。

ex.en: This passport is no longer valid, so you cannot travel with it.
ex.zh: 这本护照已失效，不能用来出行。

words.note: valid 强调法律或逻辑上有效，与 effective 侧重不同。

ex.en: It took a real effort to overcome the inertia and start exercising.
ex.zh: 他费了很大力气才克服惰性开始锻炼。

words.note: inertia 本为物理「惯性」，引申为不愿改变的惰性。

ex.en: Our teacher encouraged us to ask questions in class.
ex.zh: 老师鼓励我们在课堂上提问。

words.note: encourage sb to do sth；名词是 encouragement。

ex.en: He vacuumed the whole flat before the guests arrived.
ex.zh: 客人到来前他把整间公寓都吸尘打扫了。

words.note: vacuum 作动词指用吸尘器打扫；in a vacuum 指脱离现实。

ex.en: Her extravagant lifestyle finally left her deep in debt.
ex.zh: 她奢侈的生活方式最终让她债台高筑。

words.note: extra-（超出）加 vag（漫游），本义漫游过头，引申为挥霍。

ex.en: The new hall can accommodate up to five hundred people.
ex.zh: 新礼堂最多可容纳五百人。

words.note: 表「容纳」直接接宾语；表「适应」用 accommodate oneself to。

ex.en: The housing bubble finally burst and prices fell sharply.
ex.zh: 房地产泡沫最终破裂，房价急剧下跌。

words.note: bubble 常喻不实之物，如 economic bubble 经济泡沫。

ex.en: The novel raises questions about public morality and personal freedom.
ex.zh: 这部小说提出公共道德与个人自由的问题。

words.note: morality 指道德体系，具体道德或寓意用 moral。

ex.en: The land yields enough grain to feed the whole village.
ex.zh: 这片土地出产的粮食足以养活全村人。

words.note: yield to 表让步或屈服；作名词指产量，如 crop yield。

ex.en: Most students now prefer electronic books to paper ones.
ex.zh: 现在多数学生更喜欢电子书而不是纸质书。

words.note: electronic 是电子的，electric 是用电的。

ex.en: The patient is still waiting for a suitable heart transplant.
ex.zh: 这名病人仍在等待合适的心脏移植。

words.note: transplant 作名词重音在前，作动词重音在后。

ex.en: They had dinner on the roof terrace overlooking the river.
ex.zh: 他们在俯瞰河流的屋顶露台上吃晚饭。

words.note: terrace 指阶梯平台或露台；terraced house 指排屋。

ex.en: The country has been running a large trade deficit for years.
ex.zh: 该国多年来一直存在巨额贸易逆差。

words.note: deficit 常搭 trade/budget deficit；反义是 surplus。

ex.en: For the local people, the mountain is sacred and must not be climbed.
ex.zh: 对当地人来说，这座山是神圣的，不得攀登。

words.note: sacred 强调宗教或传统上的神圣；holy 更泛。

ex.en: We spent the morning walking around the old cathedral.
ex.zh: 我们上午绕着那座古老的大教堂散步。

words.note: cathedral 指设主教座堂的大教堂；church 泛指教堂。

ex.en: The mathematician found an elegant solution to the problem.
ex.zh: 这位数学家为这个问题找到了简洁漂亮的解法。

words.note: elegant 除优雅外，也修饰 solution，表简洁巧妙。

ex.en: The book is a synthesis of history and philosophy.
ex.zh: 这本书是历史与哲学的综合。

words.note: synthesis 复数 syntheses；动词是 synthesize。

ex.en: Incidentally, I saw your brother at the station this morning.
ex.zh: 顺便说一下，我今天早上在车站看到你哥哥了。

words.note: incidentally 用于引出题外话，相当于 by the way。

ex.en: In terms of education, their views are polar opposites.
ex.zh: 在教育问题上，他们的看法截然相反。

words.note: polar opposite 指截然相反；polar bear 是北极熊。

ex.en: The swimmers were warned that sharks had been seen near the beach.
ex.zh: 游泳者被告知海滩附近出现过鲨鱼。

words.note: loan shark 指放高利贷的人，带贬义。

ex.en: A few guests lingered in the garden long after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后很久，还有几位客人在花园里逗留。

words.note: linger 常接 on 或 over，含不愿离开、慢慢消磨之意。

ex.en: Historians still disagree about the causes of the war.
ex.zh: 历史学家对这场战争的起因仍有分歧。

words.note: historian 由 history 加 -ian 构成。

ex.en: The cumulative effect of small savings can be surprising.
ex.zh: 小额储蓄的累积效果可能出人意料。

words.note: cumulative 强调逐步累加，常见 cumulative effect。

ex.en: Engineers have built a prototype of the new engine.
ex.zh: 工程师已造出新发动机的原型。

words.note: proto-（最初）加 type（型），即原型、样机。

ex.en: We took the pedestrian overpass to cross the busy road.
ex.zh: 我们走人行天桥穿过繁忙的马路。

words.note: overpass 是美式说法，英式多用 flyover。
